items.title: 집 묘사
items.question: You indicated that you live in an apartment. Can you describe your home? What does it look like? How many rooms does it have?
script: Alright, let me tell you about my place.
I live in an apartment in Suwon, on the third floor. It has three bedrooms and two bathrooms, so it's pretty roomy for us.

**Once you step inside**, there's a hallway. As you walk down the hallway, the living room is on the left, and the kitchen is on the right. The living room is really spacious, and I keep a few plants by the window. Honestly, they make the whole place feel a lot more alive. The floor is white tile, so everything looks bright and clean. On the walls, I've hung some prints of famous paintings that I picked up on my trips. Every time I look at them, they remind me of the places I've been.

But my favorite spot, **without a doubt**, is my own room. The whole room has a walnut wood theme. The blinds, the desk, and the bookshelf are all brown, so it feels really warm, almost like a little study café. My bookshelf has lots of books on it, and I also have some figures and liquor bottles **on display**. I use my computer and read books in here, and I really love it.
So yeah, I really love my place. **It's not fancy, but it's totally me.** Honestly, it's the best.
keywords: 수원 아파트 3층 · 방 3 / 화장실 2
들어오면 복도 → 왼쪽 거실 / 오른쪽 주방
거실 넓음 · 창가에 식물 → more alive
흰 타일 바닥 → bright & clean
여행에서 사온 명화 prints → 다녀온 곳 생각남
최애: 내 방 · 월넛 테마 (블라인드·책상·책장 브라운) → study café
책장: 책 + 피규어 + 술병 on display
컴퓨터 · 독서 → really love it
마무리: not fancy, but totally me
items.notes: 'I really love'가 두 번 나오면 내 방 쪽을 'It's perfect for that.'으로 바꿔도 됨.

items.title: 좋아하는 장르
items.question: You indicated that you like to go to the movies. What kinds of movies do you like to watch? Why do you like that genre?
script: I watch various kinds of movies, but my favorite genre is **science fiction**. I especially enjoy movies **set in space**.

What I like about them is their creative stories and impressive visuals. So I always try to watch these movies at a theater, **especially in IMAX**. I want to experience the special effects on a big screen with high-quality sound. They allow me to **imagine worlds beyond daily life** and explore ideas that I don't usually think about.
Sometimes, this genre uses technical terms and require a deeper understanding. If there's something I don't understand after watching a movie, I usually **look up reviews** or buy the original novel.
**For these reasons**, science fiction is my favorite movie genre.
keywords: 여러 장르 보지만 최애는 SF · 특히 우주 배경
좋은 점: 창의적 스토리 + 영상미
그래서 항상 극장, 특히 IMAX → 큰 화면 + 좋은 사운드로 특수효과
일상 너머 세계 상상 · 평소 안 하던 생각
가끔 전문 용어 → 깊은 이해 필요
이해 안 되면 리뷰 찾아보거나 원작 소설 구매
마무리: For these reasons → 최애 장르 SF

items.title: 영화 보러 갈 때 하는 일
items.question: Tell me about what you usually do when you go to the movies. What do you do before and after the movie? Describe your routine in detail.
script: I usually make plans with my family to **catch a movie** together at least once a month.
Before watching a movie, we **arrange the details**, like when and where to go, and which movie to watch. If needed, we also book our tickets in advance **to avoid any hassle**.
Well, once we get to the theater, we **grab some snacks** like popcorn and drinks. After that, we head to the restroom to make sure we're **all set** to enjoy the movie without interruptions.
After the movie, we often go for dinner and chat about it. We love discussing the storyline, characters, memorable scenes and so on.
Sometimes, if we feel too tired, we just **head straight home** instead.
keywords: 가족과 한 달에 한 번 이상 영화
전: 언제·어디·뭘 볼지 정하기 → 필요하면 예매 (avoid hassle)
극장 도착: 팝콘·음료 → 화장실 (all set)
(끝나면 자리 정리하고 짐 챙기기)
후: 저녁 먹으며 수다 → 스토리·캐릭터·명장면
피곤하면 바로 집으로
items.notes: 원문 괄호 메모 '(clean up and pack up all items.)'는 여기로 옮겼어. 넣고 싶으면 4번째 문단 앞에 'When the movie ends, we clean up and pack up all our things.'로 말하면 돼.

items.title: 최근 영화 본 경험
items.question: Tell me about the last time you went to the movies. What movie did you see, who did you go with, and what did you do? Tell me everything from beginning to end.
script: The last time I went to the movies was a month ago. I went with my wife because we both wanted to see Project Hail Mary. Since it was a space movie, we decided to watch it **in IMAX** at the largest CGV in our neighborhood.

Well, once we got to the theater, we grabbed some snacks like popcorn and drinks. After that, we headed to the restroom to make sure we could enjoy the movie without interruptions. Then we found our seats and watched the movie. When it ended, we **cleaned up our area** and **gathered our belongings**.

After the movie, we went out for dinner and chatted about it. We discussed the storyline, the characters, and some memorable scenes. It was interesting to hear **which parts my wife enjoyed the most**.
Overall, it was a pretty enjoyable day!
keywords: 한 달 전 · 아내와 · 프로젝트 헤일메리
우주 영화라 동네 제일 큰 CGV IMAX
팝콘·음료 → 화장실 → 자리 찾아 관람
끝나고 자리 정리 · 짐 챙기기
저녁 먹으며 스토리·캐릭터·명장면 얘기
아내가 어느 부분 제일 좋았는지 듣는 게 재밌었음
마무리: pretty enjoyable day

items.title: 영화 관련 뉴스
items.question: Tell me about a recent news story about a movie or an actor. What was the news about, and why was it interesting to you?
script: I remember reading an article about Ryan Gosling, one of my favorite actors. I've enjoyed his movies for a long time, especially The Notebook and La La Land, so I was interested in hearing about his next movie.

The article said that he would **play the lead role** in Project Hail Mary, a science fiction movie **based on a novel**. Since I enjoy movies set in space, the news **immediately caught my attention**.

After hearing the news, I visited a bookstore and noticed copies of Project Hail Mary **on display everywhere**. What surprised me most was the cover. Instead of the original cover, the books had Ryan Gosling on the front. I thought it was interesting to see how the movie was changing **the way the book was presented**.
Seeing his face on the book cover made me even more interested in watching the movie. I was already a fan of his, but after that visit to the bookstore, I was **really looking forward to it**.

헤일메리 주연 · 소설 원작 SF

놀란 점: 표지가 원작 대신 고슬링 얼굴
영화가 책 보여주는 방식까지 바꿈
